user_id.description: Developer-asserted customer subject within the authenticated project; not independently verified end-user authentication. sdk-user disables private memory.
user_id.title: User Id

thread_id.description: Runtime thread identifier used to bind checkpoint state.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

session_id.description: Optional session identifier used for tool execution context.
session_id.title: Session Id

redaction_preview_id.description: Opaque sealed redaction preview approval; consumed once by the data plane.
redaction_preview_id.title: Redaction Preview Id

invocation_id.description: Optional invocation identifier for trace and retry correlation.
invocation_id.title: Invocation Id

project_id.description: Optional project identifier used for policy and spend attribution.
project_id.title: Project Id

organization_id.description: Organization the run belongs to; stamped from the authenticated caller.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

agent_id.description: Agent scope this run executes as; required to reach agent-bound memory.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

swarm_id.description: Swarm scope this run executes as; required to reach swarm-bound memory.
swarm_id.title: Swarm Id

client_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone reported by the invoking SDK client.
client_timezone.title: Client Timezone

sdk_deployment_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone configured for the SDK deployment.
sdk_deployment_timezone.title: Sdk Deployment Timezone

model_directive.description: Optional runtime model directive selected at invocation time.
model_directive.title: Model Directive

routing_preference.description: Ask auto routing to lean faster, cheaper, or stronger than the request content alone would pick. Absent means no preference. Only auto routing reads it; every other directive already names its own tier. One value rather than separate flags, because these are mutually exclusive and a caller cannot ask for two at once.
routing_preference.title: Routing Preference

system_model_choices.description: Optional explicit model choices for framework-owned system tools. Absent preserves each tool's internal default profile.

max_expense_usd.description: Optional lower total mAIvn execution expense ceiling in exact USD. Capped runs exclude paid hosted search/sandbox and background enrichment. This limits new work and never changes customer billing rates.
max_expense_usd.title: Max Expense Usd

planning.description: Optional model choice for framework-owned planning.

job_depth.description: Execution-tree depth for nested assignment replay and ordering.
job_depth.title: Job Depth

job_index.description: Execution-tree sibling index for causal ordering within a parent.
job_index.title: Job Index

parent_assignment_uuid.description: Optional parent assignment UUID for nested job lineage.
parent_assignment_uuid.title: Parent Assignment Uuid

child_run_kind.description: Absent means an ordinary root invocation, matching the other lineage fields beside it, so an existing run config serializes byte-identically. What KIND of child run this is, not merely that it is one. `job_depth` alone cannot answer this: a swarm member and a decomposed tool job both report depth 1, so any consumer trying to prove a job ran was reduced to guessing from names. `decision_run` also marks a decision-only run, which is a root run with no model loop.
child_run_kind.title: Child Run Kind

plan_node_id.description: Stable identifier of the plan node this run executes. Survives retries and re-planning, which a sibling ordinal does not.
plan_node_id.title: Plan Node Id

decomposition_depth.description: How many JOB boundaries deep this run is, counted separately from `job_depth`. They diverge as soon as a swarm delegates: a swarm hop raises job_depth without spending any of the decomposition budget, and conflating them would let a few agent hops exhaust the job allowance.
decomposition_depth.title: Decomposition Depth

recursion_limit.description: Runtime cycle guard; defaults to the v1 parity value of 100.
recursion_limit.title: Recursion Limit

durability.description: Checkpoint persistence mode; exit persists at run exit or interrupt.
durability.title: Durability

origin.description: Optional self-reported invoking client, display/filter only, never consulted for authorization. Conventional starting set: studio, alpha, portal, sdk. Not an enforced enum - unrecognized values from newer clients are accepted and read back as-is; absent on historical rows.
origin.title: Origin

thread_id.description: Runtime thread identifier for the queried state.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

run_id.description: Runtime run identifier for this state snapshot.
run_id.title: Run Id

values.description: Open runtime state values visible to state readers.
values.title: Values

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp for when the snapshot was observed.
ts.title: Ts
